settings.title: Site settings
settings.desc: Site name, home copy, contact details and footer; changes go live immediately
settings.demoImported: Demo content imported: {{total}} added, {{skipped}} existing skipped
settings.demoImportWarn: Writes the brand's sample products and news (insert-only), and replaces brand identity content entirely: site name, home copy, navigation and feature cards; safe to repeat.

message.title: Messages
message.desc: Messages submitted through the contact page. New ones notify the right people; opening one marks it as read.
message.name: Name
message.notifyEmailHint: Send a copy of every new message to the contact email above. Skipped automatically when SMTP is not configured. In-app notifications are always sent.
message.consent: Messages require consent to the privacy policy
message.consentHint: When on, the contact page adds a required checkbox and submissions without it are rejected. Recommended for delivered client sites — collecting a name, phone and email is processing personal data.

nav.title: Navigation
nav.desc: Top navigation of the public site; supports nesting (up to {{max}} levels) and drag to reorder
nav.deleteBatchConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected navigation item(s)? Their child links are deleted too.
nav.errNoSlash: Enter a full site path or a full URL.
nav.errNoSlashHint: Site paths start with / (e.g. /p/about); external URLs start with https://.
nav.errUnknownPath: The site has no page at “{{path}}”.
nav.errUnknownHint1: Pick an existing page from the “Link target” list above.
nav.errUnknownHint2: To add a page, create it under “Pages” first, then pick it here.
nav.errPageMissingHint: Create a page with this slug under “Pages”, then pick it here.

feature.title: Features
feature.desc: Items in the “Also built in” index on the home page

page.title: Pages
page.desc: Custom single pages at /p/:slug, e.g. About
page.statusPartial: Updated {{updated}}/{{total}} (the rest may have just been deleted)
page.navExists: This page is already in the navigation

post.title: News
post.scheduledHint: Publish time is in the future; it goes live on the site then
post.categorySlugInvalid: This name can't become a slug; type one — lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1-64 long.
post.categoryDeleteConfirm: Delete category "{{name}}"? {{count}} posts will no longer belong to it.
post.tagInputPlaceholder: Type a topic, then Enter or comma to add
post.tagLimit: A post takes at most {{max}} tags; remove one to add another.
post.tagDeleteConfirm: Delete tag "{{name}}"? It will be removed from {{count}} posts too.
post.versionsHint: Every save that changes the body archives the previous content, keeping the latest {{max}} versions. Rollback re-saves historical content — the current one is archived first, and the rollback itself can be rolled back.
post.versionsEmpty: No versions yet: this post has no body-changing overwrite yet.
post.rollbackConfirm: Roll back to v{{version}}? The current content is archived as a new version first and stays recoverable.

product.title: Products
product.desc: Website product centre at /products/:slug; fields mirror Alibaba listing and keep sync fields for one-click publish
product.categoriesEmpty: No categories yet — create one under "Product categories" first
product.coverHint: Suggested 800×800; also used as the social share preview
product.videoHint: Click the card to upload (resumable; size limit under System Parameters → Upload Limits), or paste a video URL directly
product.englishTitleRequired: Fill in the English title before publishing: English is the master copy for Alibaba sync

ali.configDesc: Credentials of a self-use app on the Alibaba.com open platform; secret and session key are encrypted and never shown again
ali.testFail: Connection failed: check AppKey/AppSecret and the gateway URL
ali.categoryLeafHint: Only leaf categories (deepest level) can be picked: click a non-leaf to go deeper
ali.englishHint: Publishes the English master copy with main image & gallery (images uploaded to the Alibaba photobank automatically)
ali.jobDone: Job finished; per-product sync status and failure reasons are updated in the list

productCategory.title: Product categories
productCategory.desc: Product categories (mirroring Alibaba groups), up to {{max}} levels with drag-and-drop ordering
productCategory.slugInvalid: Slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (1-64 chars)
productCategory.name: Name
productCategory.deleteConfirm: Delete category "{{name}}"? It still holds {{count}} products — move them out first.
productCategory.deleteBatchConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected categories? Subcategories go with them.

editor.preparingHint: Loading the field schema and language list.
editor.loadFailed: The form can't open right now
editor.loadFailedHint: The field schema request failed. Retry, or check your network and permissions.

fields.coverPlaceholder: Paste an image URL, or click Upload
fields.coverHint: 1200×630 recommended; uploads are cropped to that ratio and used as the social preview image
fields.ogImageHint: The picture shown in the link preview card on WeChat, X and similar chat apps; leave empty to use the site default
fields.ogHint: 1200×630 recommended; uploads are cropped to that ratio
fields.coverInvalid: Use a full URL (https://…) or a site path starting with /
fields.slugAuto: Leave blank to generate from the title
fields.sortHint: Lower values come first; 0 = unset (sorted last)
fields.publishedAtHint: Left empty, it is recorded automatically when published; set a future time to schedule
fields.productKeywordsPlaceholder: 1-3 English words, space-separated, used for Alibaba.com publishing, e.g. water pump stainless
fields.postSummaryAuto: Left empty, it is derived from the content
fields.author: Author

hint.homeTitle: Use a line break for two lines; the last line renders as gradient text
hint.logoUrl: Image URL, or upload with the button ({{types}}, ≤{{max}}); leave empty for the built-in letter mark
hint.faviconUrl: {{types}}; leave empty for the built-in favicon.svg
hint.ogImageUrl: Fallback share image when content has none, 1200×630 recommended; leave empty to use the built-in one
hint.headCode: Injected as-is into every page's <head> (GA / Baidu Analytics / site verification); configurable only by site-settings admins who own the script content, limited to 5000 characters
hint.titleSuffix: Appended after page titles, replacing " - SiteName"; leave empty to use the site name
hint.theme: Themes come from theme plugins and take effect right after saving; when a theme plugin is uninstalled the site falls back to the default theme without downtime
hint.demoImport: Writes the brand's sample products and news (insert-only), and replaces brand identity (site name / home copy / navigation / feature cards); safe to repeat
hint.homeSlug: Pick a custom page to serve as the site homepage (replaces the built-in hero page). Deleted or unpublished pages fall back to the built-in home; a draft takes effect once published
hint.qrCodeUrl: Shown in the footer and on the contact page; leave empty to hide the QR code
hint.socials: Social icons in the footer and on the contact page; up to {{max}}, https:// or mailto:
hint.friendLinks: The “Links” column in the footer; up to {{max}}, hidden when empty
hint.navHref: Pick a site page here. Choose “Custom link” for an external URL (must start with https://) or an in-page anchor.

qr.uploaded: QR code uploaded — remember to save

placeholder.siteDesc: One-line intro used in title and search snippets
placeholder.homeTitle:
A full-stack framework
built for production admin systems
placeholder.logoUrl: https://… or upload with the button on the right
placeholder.qrCodeUrl: Upload a QR image or paste its URL

market.enabledHint: When off, the public site hides all marketplace links and pages. The admin marketplace is unaffected.

i18n.machineHint: Machine translated, not reviewed by a human yet
i18n.switchHint: Switching language rebinds the whole form to that language

languages.manageHint: To add or change languages, go to System settings → Languages: the site and the admin UI share one language list. Restart the server afterwards so the public site registers routes for the new prefixes.
